title: Streaming JSON contract sampler & cross-model compatibility evaluation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a reproducible sampling and evaluation harness that stresses streaming JSON mode and constrained decoders across multiple model families and runtime variants. The goal is to quantify backward-compatibility risk when we roll runtime or model upgrades and to surface actionable failures (schema violations, truncated tool calls, incorrect rollbacks) that can be triaged by runtime, model-onboarding, or SDK teams. This ticket focuses on the test harness, sampling strategy, and automated regression detection; remediation (fixes) will be tracked as follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic harness can generate 10k streaming scenarios with schema, prompt, tool-call interleaving, and partial-chunk permutations
The harness runs against at least three model/runtime combos (hosted-vX, dedicated-vX, private-vX) and produces a per-scenario pass/fail with a JSON-parsable report
Regression thresholds and alerting rules are defined: >3% absolute drop in schema pass-rate triggers an alert and creates ENG tickets for the owning teams
Sampled failing scenarios are automatically stored in the artifact bucket and linked in the regression report for on-call triage
test_plan: Design a sampling distribution that mixes short/long prefixes, high/low entropy continuations, and tool-call interleavings (sync tool-call, async token-inserted tool-call)
Implement streaming simulator that emits partial deltas and intentional token truncations to emulate network jitter and early connection loss
Integrate constrained-decoder runner (our decoder shim) and a golden JSON validator that tolerates safe schema relaxations (field ordering, optional fields) but flags structural violations
Run the suite across target model/runtime matrix and collect per-scenario signals: parse-failure, schema-mismatch, toolcall-orphan, truncated-array, incorrect-type
Compute aggregated metrics, compare to baseline (hosted-v1.19), and produce a dashboard + daily regression digest
updates: 2026-03-10: Ticket created after weekly infra sync; initial sampling design sketched with PM and QA
2026-03-11: Decided to include interleaved tool-call scenarios after reproducing a live customer incident where function call tokens were split across stream chunks (see incident notes)

2026-03-12: Prototype harness implemented; discovered decoder shim throws on single-quote escapes in partial streams. Temporary mitigation: pre-scan and escape sanitizer in simulator (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482)
2026-03-13: Threshold debate: team agreed on 3% absolute regression threshold and a soft-warn bucket at 1.5% for experimental rollouts. Filed follow-up ENG-811221 for remediation playbooks
